# FPOImg

> {{ description }}

Images are geometric placeholders with text and colors for layouts and mockups.
PNG is the default; .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, and .svg select other formats.
GET requests return image bytes. Use the request URL directly as an HTML img src.

## API and reference

- [API documentation]({{ origin }}/docs): Server-rendered endpoint, parameter, default, and response reference.
- [OpenAPI specification]({{ origin }}/openapi.json): Machine-readable contract for all image routes.
- [Usage examples]({{ origin }}/examples): Placeholder sizes, captions, and colors.
- [Gradient presets and builder]({{ origin }}/gradients): Preset and custom gradient backgrounds.
- [Named color reference]({{ origin }}/colors): CSS names for background, text, and gradient colors.

## Quick start

- Basic PNG: {{ origin }}/800x600
- Caption: {{ origin }}/400x300?text=Hello+World
- Gradient: {{ origin }}/1200x630?gradient=ocean&text=Blog+Cover&dims=false
- SVG: {{ origin }}/400x300.svg?bg_color=steelblue&text_color=white

Prefer query parameters for captions and colors to avoid ambiguous path segments.
URL-encode query values. Encode # as %23 in hex colors, or omit #.
Dimensions are clamped to the supported range; consult the API reference for limits.
The docs and OpenAPI specification describe supported parameters and fallback behavior.
